# Barndo Insurance — barndoinsurance.com

> Specialty insurance for barndominium owners — dwelling, builders risk, shop coverage, and farm/ranch policies for barndominiums that standard carriers decline or misclassify.

## About

Barndo Insurance is a specialty division of Contractors Choice Agency (CCA). CCA has provided specialty insurance solutions since 2005, licensed in all 50 states. NPN: 8608479. Phone: 844-967-5247. Email: josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Services

- Barndominium Dwelling Insurance: Replacement cost property coverage for completed barndominiums — specialty markets that correctly value and write steel-frame structures.
- Builders Risk Insurance: Construction phase coverage from first material delivery to occupancy, including steel kit materials on-site.
- Shop & Workshop Coverage: Coverage for barndo shop sections, scheduled tools, and in-home business endorsements for commercial workspace use.
- Farm & Ranch Barndo Insurance: Farm/ranch package policies for barndominiums on working agricultural land — dwelling, livestock, equipment, and farm liability.
- Flood Insurance: NFIP and private flood insurance for rural barndo properties, including elevation certificate guidance.

## Key Coverage Questions

- Why is barndominium insurance hard to get? Standard carriers lack actuarial data on steel-frame construction and struggle with mixed-use classification.
- Do I need a farm/ranch policy or homeowners for my barndo? Farm/ranch if you have livestock, equipment, or agricultural income; specialty dwelling or DP3 otherwise.
- What does barndominium insurance cost? Typically ,000–,500/year for a completed dwelling on replacement cost.
- When does builders risk coverage start? When the first materials are delivered to the construction site.
